provenance.notes: Manually reconstructed from the inspected original flattened PDF figure. Ordinary labels are live typeable text; panels, graph geometry and arrows are native editable shapes or paths. Source layout and contents retained; font metrics, line widths and decorative effects approximated. Five manipulation benchmark snapshots, the scene photograph, gear brand icon and five small robot/notepad illustrations remain isolated raster crops. All task cards, task examples, labels, flow arrows, status legend, improvement-loop geometry and deployment trend are native.
provenance.visual_inspection: Original PDF figure inspected before source-layout reconstruction on 2026-10-09; independent application QA pending.
